location.section: Uttarakhaṇḍa (the chapter classifying the Purāṇas and śāstras by guṇa)

paraphrase: Śiva tells Pārvatī that the doctrine of illusion (māyāvāda) is a false scripture, called 'Buddhism in disguise' (pracchanna bauddha), and that he himself propounds it in the Kali age in the form of a brahmin.
speaker: Śiva
notes: The verse is quoted by Vaiṣṇava and other critics of Advaita (e.g. Vijñānabhikṣu, the Gauḍīyas); its verse number differs between editions (low confidence on the ref). A polemical text, recorded for dsp:advaita-crypto-buddhism, not a verdict.

location.section: Brahmakhaṇḍa 25.15-18 (local peterFreund e-text); cited by Gauḍīya authors

paraphrase: The ten offences against the name: reviling the saints, regarding Śiva's names and qualities as independent of Viṣṇu's, disregarding the teacher, deriding scripture, taking the name's glory as exaggeration, giving interpretations of it, sinning on the strength of the name, equating it with ordinary pious acts, teaching it to the faithless, and lacking love for it though hearing its glory.
speaker: Sanatkumāra (as cited)
notes: Locator is not a verse number: the list is cited from the Padma Purāṇa by Gauḍīya authors (e.g. Hari-bhakti-vilāsa); wording and order from memory - low confidence.

location.ref: Uttarakhaṇḍa, Śiva to Pārvatī on the heretical (pāṣaṇḍa/tāmasa) teachings (verse numbering varies by edition)

paraphrase: Among the heretical teachings Mahādeva tells the Goddess: the doctrine of māyā (māyāvāda) is a false teaching, said to be Buddhism in disguise (pracchanna-bauddha); it was taught by me, O Goddess, in the Kali age in the form of a brāhmaṇa; in the great scripture of the Vedānta I shall expound this non-Vedic māyāvāda, for the destruction of the worlds.

original.text: मायावादम् असच् छास्त्रं प्रच्छन्नं बौद्धम् उच्यते । मयैवं कथितं देवि कलौ ब्राह्मण-रूपिणा ॥ वेदान्ते तु महा-शास्त्रे मायावादम् अवैदिकम् । मयैव वक्ष्यते देवि जगतां नाश-कारणात् ॥
original.edition: as quoted by Jīva Gosvāmī, Paramātmasandarbha anuccheda 71 ('pādmottara-khaṇḍe'), GRETIL Devanāgarī e-text

speaker: Śiva (Mahādeva)
notes: Text verified only as quoted in the Paramātmasandarbha (another local witness, the eBhāratī Aṣṭādaśapurāṇadarpaṇa, reads 'mayaiva kathitaṃ devi').
